games.t: Arkham Horror (3rd Ed.) + Secrets of the Order & Under Dark Waves exps.
games.sum: Investigators comb Arkham's neighborhoods for clues to stop an eldritch doom; two big expansions add Innsmouth and more.
Race a doom clock, rolling dice to seal an Ancient One inside a haunted museum.
A puzzle-driven escape adventure set in Arkham Horror's cursed fishing town.
An app runs the haunted estate while players explore, solve puzzles, and slowly lose their minds.
Crew a 1913 steamship under Deep One attack while hidden hybrid traitors sabotage from within.

games.t: Betrayal at House on the Hill (2nd Ed.)
games.sum: Explore a growing haunted house until one player turns traitor in a randomly drawn haunt.

games.t: Betrayal at House on the Hill (3rd Ed.)
games.sum: The streamlined current edition with all-new haunts — and the base the Yuletide Tale expansion plugs into.
A multi-generation campaign where the house remembers your family's sins between games.
Betrayal's haunt system relocated to the streets and sewers of Baldur's Gate.
Krampus-flavored holiday haunts for your 3rd Edition — a natural December game night pick.
A 20-minute tarot-styled card game: defeat the Curse together while a possible traitor works against you.
A colony battles cold, zombies, and morale while every survivor pursues a hidden agenda.
Small-town heroes face off against zombie-controlling players in cinematic scenarios.
Fight through a randomly built city of undead — first survivor to reach the City's Edge wins.

games.t: Camp Grizzly (2nd Ed.) + Camp Grounds exp.
games.sum: Counselors scramble to escape Camp Nakwakto before Otis, the bear-masked killer, finds them.
You are the last one standing against a horror-movie killer; swappable film boxes change villain and location.
Patients fight through hallucinated horrors, room by room, to escape the asylum.
Puritans build their village while hidden witches quietly spread despair.

games.t: Buffy the Vampire Slayer: The Board Game (Jasco)
games.sum: The Scoobies patrol Sunnydale, clearing threats before the Big Bad completes its plan.

games.t: Buffy the Vampire Slayer: The Game (Milton Bradley, 2000)
games.sum: The vintage Buffy board game — heroes race the forces of darkness across Sunnydale.

games.t: Vampire: The Masquerade Rivals — The Hunters & The Hunted
games.sum: Vampire coteries and Hunter cells battle for the city in the Rivals ECG line.
Trick-taking one-upmanship at Pierce & Pierce, where a killer suit trumps every meeting and bodies pile up as negative points.
A big-group hidden-role game — find the infected before they spread.
Princesses build decks and brawl until only one survives when the clock strikes twelve (Darrington Press).
Play Mothman or Bigfoot: stay hidden, steer the humans, and reveal yourself at the perfect moment to build your legend.
CircleToonsHD's chaotic card game of crafting absurd swords, questing, and sabotaging friends.
Peek at identities and pull triggers to take out the other side's leader before yours gets shot.
Spies sabotage missions from within — accuse, deduce, and bluff with no player elimination.
One chaotic night of secretly swapped roles, then one vote to lynch a werewolf — or an innocent.
Twenty Questions with a hidden werewolf quietly sabotaging the guessing.
Techno-magic gunslingers duel one another or team up through a strange Forgotten West campaign.
Gather resources, transform into your shadow form, and blast rivals off the map (Unstable Games).
Make your storybook characters miserable and kill them off using see-through stacking cards.
Evolve delightful little creatures to survive the end of the world with the most points.
Point foam pistols at fellow gangsters and bluff your way to the biggest cut of the loot.
Guess where a hidden target sits on a spectrum from a teammate's single clue.
Guide the table to one exact color square using only one- and two-word clues.
One-word clues steer your team to the right agents on a five-by-five word grid.
Codenames with surreal images instead of words — clue your team to the right pictures.
Draw cards and don't explode — defuse, skip, and shuffle disaster onto your friends.
Assemble a party of adventurers and slay monsters, or sabotage everyone else's party instead.
Afflict your opponents' organs and be the last player with a functioning body.
Write the answer you think everyone else will write; stray from the herd and you're stuck with the cow.
Give clues using only one-syllable words or get bopped with the inflatable club.
Interview for absurd jobs using the random qualification cards in your hand.
Build an escape rocket together in fifteen real-time minutes — but there aren't enough seats.
Silent-table Texas hold'em: rank your hands correctly as a team to crack the safe.
Fill in the blank with the most horrible answer your judge will love.
Read a prompt, write something funny, then guess who wrote what.
When symbols match, race to shout an example of your opponent's category first.
Keep flipping for points but bust on a duplicate — seven unique cards is the jackpot.
Suburban wizards one-up the neighbors with mythical pets and HOA-grade pettiness.
Follow ridiculous card rules without cracking — laugh-until-you-cry family party game.

games.t: Heart and Brain: The Party Game
games.sum: Challenges, dares, and scenarios from the Heart and Brain webcomic.
Pass gifts around the table and bluff about what's on the face-down card, because nobody remembers.
Guess who's telling the truth and who's making it up.
Act, describe, and quote your way through movie prompts.
Race the timer to name unique things in each category starting with the rolled letter.
Nobody knows the answers — bet on whichever guess at the table looks closest.
Stack the trolley tracks with innocents and monsters, then argue who deserves to get run over.
Bend and connect cards corner-to-corner in a growing tabletop web.
Pull blocks, restack them, and try not to be the one who topples the tower.
Lay hex tiles to grow a peaceful countryside and complete villagers' requests together.
Run an English estate, court the gentry, and manage your servants in Austen-era society.
The crossword-building classic on a deluxe rotating board.
Hidden ranks clash as two armies hunt each other's flag.
Trade wood for sheep and race to ten points settling the island.
A chip-stacking gem engine where cheap cards discount better ones until prestige piles up.
Forest critters build a charming city of cards across the seasons beneath the Ever Tree.
Wingspan's engine-building reworked around excavating caves and attracting dragons.
Slide wooden discs to shove rival beetles out of the sumo ring.
Place workers, then send warriors to dice it out with trolls and draugr for glory.

games.t: Lords of Waterdeep (+ Scoundrels of Skullport exp.)
games.sum: Masked lords complete quests and play intrigue in D&D's most famous city; the expansion adds corruption and a sixth player.
A massive legacy-style campaign of card-driven tactical dungeon combat.
Brain-burning deckbuilt exploration and conquest; brutal solo, co-op, or competitive.
Restore the valley and the community center together, one season at a time.
A diceless co-op RPG: build characters, gather resources, and topple procedurally generated monsters.
Little pigs race to build houses while fable cards and a huffing wolf wreck plans.
Fight the War of the Lance in scenario battles tied to the Dragonlance novels.
Rival dungeon lords excavate and build the nastiest dungeon (Tin Hat Games).
A pocket dungeon crawl: roll dice to beat encounters, level up, and face the boss.

games.t: Command of Nature (x3 boxes incl. exps.)
games.sum: Sages summon Twig, Leaf, Droplet, and Pebble warriors in a head-to-head (or 2v2) formation battle.
Arrival-inspired table talk: decode an alien language that rewrites your characters' memories.
A pick-your-path adventure run on real-time dexterity minigames (about 40 minutes).
Cure four diseases before outbreaks cascade across the globe.
A year-long campaign where the world — and your physical board — changes permanently. You own both the blue and red box variants.
Dig a buried flying machine out of a shifting, storm-blasted desert before you run out of water.
Lay path tiles and stay on the board — elegantly cutthroat in fifteen minutes.
Build a settlement and climb the social ladder in the Five Realms.
Each villain chases their own movie-specific win condition while heroes get flung in their way.

games.t: A Game of Thrones: The Board Game
games.sum: Alliances, betrayal, and armies as the great houses fight for the Iron Throne.
The legendary friendship-ender: no dice, just promises you're going to break.
Steer a collaborative fairy tale toward your secret ending using story cards.
Place workers inside a human cell to build proteins and enzymes — real science, solid euro.
Run a fledgling TV network: sign stars, land ads, and chase viewers with terrible shows.
Yahtzee-style dice, giant monsters, one Tokyo — smash your way to king of the hill.
Kill the monsters, steal the treasure, stab your buddy.
Munchkin dressed up as the Mighty Nein.
An invisible thief sneaks around the board making app sound clues — triangulate and catch them.

games.t: EXIT: The Game — The Sunken Treasure
games.sum: A one-time-play puzzle box: escape the sunken shipwreck by solving (and destroying) the components.

games.t: Star Trek Strange New Worlds: Mary Celeste
games.sum: An escape-room adventure aboard the Enterprise, chasing the mystery of the Mary Celeste.
A space-probe race featuring real imagery from New Horizons, Voyager, Juno, and Cassini.
A wooden-box family game for hikers, made for trail lovers, teachers, and scouts.
Learn hiking first aid, Leave No Trace camping, plant ID, and trail history as you play.
Build the language of an isolated community — and watch it die — in this quietly devastating RPG.
One small deck, five different two-player games of deduction and bluffing.

games.t: The Tea Dragon Society Card Game
games.sum: Gentle deck-building about raising your very own tea dragon through the seasons.
Beach City card battles with the Crystal Gems.

games.t: Trivial Pursuit: The Nightmare Before Christmas (quick play)
games.sum: Bite-size Trivial Pursuit stuffed with Halloween Town questions.
The classic whodunit re-skinned with the Belcher family.
Buy up Bob's Burgers landmarks in themed Monopoly.
Jack Skellington Monopoly with collectible pewter tokens.

games.t: Magic: The Gathering (Bloomburrow Commander decks + Avatar: The Last Airbender)
games.sum: Preconstructed Commander decks and sets for multiplayer Magic nights.
Liberals pass policies and sniff out lies while secret fascists scheme to elect Hitler chancellor.
Stack wobbly folded-cardboard cats as the dice demand — don't be the one who topples the pile.

games.t: Sign: A Game About Being Understood
games.sum: From Dialect's makers: play deaf children in 1970s Nicaragua inventing a language together, played largely in silence.
The sun is going supernova: build your ark, launch in time, and survive the journey to humanity's new home.
A vast card-built continent you explore, forage, and probably die on across long, save-able expeditions.
Mech-farming factions expand across war-scarred Europa — resource engines, tense standoffs, gorgeous art.
A drag-themed party game of fierce matchups and even fiercer judging.
Monopoly in sleek silver-and-black.
Themed mini card packs to shuffle into your Codenames nights.

games.t: Star Trek Picard: Murder on the Titan-A
games.sum: Analyze evidence and scan the AR Starfleet badge to clear Captain Shaw of a Klingon councilor's murder.
Deck-built investigators play through branching narrative campaigns (1-2 players per core set; 4 with two cores).
Grow a sculptural wooden tree branch by branch and blossom your flowers in the best spots.

notes: Joking Hazard — you own an expansion pack but not the base game yet (wishlist item!)
